fusions.name: Word of Halting
fusions.desc: You point the staff and speak the halting word. A bolt strikes the first enemy within 9 tiles, deals 12 damage and stuns it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Recited Over
fusions.desc: On the closing word of a recitation you thrust the staff at an enemy up to 4 tiles away that carries one of your afflictions, using that affliction up. It deals 8 damage, up to 1.3 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Measured Cadence
fusions.desc: You beat time on the staff as you cast, raising your casting speed by 25% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Practised Phrasing
fusions.desc: When your mana fills, the words line up along the staff and your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 10 seconds.
